title: arabidopsis lyrata
intro: Arabidopsis lyrata, commonly known as rockcress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Arabidopsis lyrata are attributed to its ability to modulate the activity of various enzymes and hormones, as well as its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
